goal: Speed up initial block download and chainstate reindexing by removing disk read stalls from block validation
Avoids stalling the main validation thread while reading and deserializing blocks from disk
agreement: Strong support with verified benchmark speedups during reindexing and initial sync (andrewtoth)
Checked potential concurrency race conditions with pruning and indexes and found none (arejula27)
Prior concern about memory retention on invalid branches was resolved (w0xlt)
Only minor open suggestions remain on doc comments and an early return (andrewtoth, arejula27)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it noticeably speeds up node synchronization and reindexing across both SSD and HDD storage
Author benchmarks show up to 1.53x reindex speedup on HDD and 1.30x on SSD with verified reviewer gains
